notes: Product: VS Code extension (marketplace + enterprise bundle). Focus: ultra-low-latency inline suggestions and streaming completions.
Current architecture: extension sends keystroke deltas to a thin proxy, proxy aggregates to backend LLM. Concern: user-level rate limits, token cost per keystroke.
Customer quote on call: 'If suggestions feel laggy devs will disable the extension — latency is the product.'
Asks: model pinning per workspace, per-org routing to dedicated capacity during peak, offline/airgap option for regulated customers.
Interested in Redwood Optimize for batching/caching rules—want automated prefix cache for common code snippets.
Security: SSO via SAML, audit logs for suggestion acceptance, retention controls for snippets, HSM/KMS for keys. Data residency: EU for EU customers.
Budget: procurement expects 12-month committed spend for Dedicated for enterprise accounts; testing Hosted for small customers.
Notes about UX: prefer streaming partial tokens to line-buffered completions; prefer incremental token diffs to reduce billing noise.
Perf expectations: p50 <35ms for inline, p95 <120ms; throughput target 800 concurrent active devs for top tier customers.
SE to validate: how Redwood calculates tokens for streaming/partial updates; client-side rate-limit guidance for VS Code extension.
Escalation: INF-4321 opened for initial infra questions; SEC-5572 tracking security questionnaire gaps.
